init.title: Zone players
init.description:
Link each zone to its DLNA renderer and, if it has one, its AirPlay player. Media played to a zone then goes to its own renderer, so every room can play something different.

Zones sharing a renderer are grouped automatically. Removing one from the group moves it to the source below, so it stops hearing the shared audio; joining it again puts it back.

With **wake the zone automatically** on, starting playback on either linked player switches that zone on and selects the network input.

**Your zones:**
{zone_names}

data.leave_source: Source for a zone that leaves a group
